notes.content:
- Added a Bongbong accessory to the pistol when Nell wears the Abyss School costume.

※ We have received reports that fatal errors continued to occur even after our previous update, which was intended to fix them.
In our testing environment, we mistakenly believed the issue was resolved as no further fatal errors occurred.
In this version, we have made further improvements to the suspected causes of the fatal errors.
We sincerely apologize for not providing a stable gameplay experience and will strive to conduct more thorough testing.
Thank you.

notes.title: 02/08 (Sat) Update - Fatal Error related fixes
notes.content:
- Disabled physics async

※We are currently unable to find the exact cause of the Fatal Error.
We are having difficulty finding the problem because the error does not occur frequently in our test environment.
We have updated by disabling physics async, which is expected.
This function was added for optimization purposes, so there may be frame drops.
For those who were experiencing Fatal Error before, please let us know if the issue was resolved with this update.

We apologize to the players who always suffer due to our lack of skills,
and we sincerely thank you for joining us on our journey.
We will continue to work hard to provide a more comfortable playing environment.

notes.title: 12/07 (Sat) Update - Added Custom Nurse and Bosol Motion
notes.content:
○Added Function
- "Custom Nurse" extra option will be added to the extra menu.

※ You can select the parts to be randomly equipped when a Nurse Creature is created through the "Custom Nurse" function.

○Added Bosol Motion and Balancing
- 3 Bosol motions will be added.
- Bosol's health will be doubled, and the damage received in the giant state will be reduced from 1/4 to 1/10.

※ Balancing is always a part that makes users uncomfortable, but

The existing difficulty was too easy, so there were not many opportunities to show Bosol's motion,
We raised it this time because there were a lot of additional bullets and recovery items in the basement.

Since Bosol's difficulty is not difficult,
we modified it with the hope that you will enjoy Bosol's motion a little more,
but if it has a negative effect on the user's playing experience, we will modify it without delay.

○ Improvements
